## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (0 errors)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I tested the change locally with `npm run dev`
- [ ] No secrets, `.env.local` values, or personal data are included
- [ ] Citizen-facing text does not use the words "scraper", "scraping" or "scraped"
- [ ] If `prisma/schema.prisma` changed: I said so in the description (the maintainer must run `npm run db:push` against production BEFORE this merges — the build never mutates the database)
